guidance: Make the run of show executable on the day. Roles need clear ownership and a reachable contact. Checklist items need status, not just names. Keep logistics complete but short.

outline.title: Event Overview
outline.guidance: Goal and logistics for the event.

children.title: The Goal
children.guidance: Primary purpose or vibe of the event.

children.title: Logistics
children.guidance: Date, time, timezone, and location or link.

children.title: Role
children.guidance: Title each instance with role or person name, not "Role".

children.title: Responsibilities
children.guidance: What this person owns on the day.

children.title: Contact Info
children.guidance: How to reach them in an emergency.

outline.title: Run of Show
outline.guidance: Timed schedule blocks for the event.

children.title: Schedule Block
children.guidance: Title each instance with time + activity label, not "Schedule Block".

children.title: Time & Activity
children.guidance: When it happens and what is happening.

outline.title: Equipment & Vendors
outline.guidance: Vendors and gear checklist. Wrapper is always present; omit items when none.

children.title: Item
children.guidance: Title each instance with the vendor or equipment name.

children.title: Status
children.guidance: Needs ordering, confirmed, or ready—plus any critical note.
